traits.name: Career Progression Velocity
traits.definition: Rate of advancement, promotions, and role elevation over time
traits.evidence: Job titles showing increasing seniority, promotions within companies

traits.name: Tenure Stability Pattern
traits.definition: Balance between job stability and strategic career mobility
traits.evidence: Length of time at each position, frequency of job changes

traits.name: Role Complexity Evolution
traits.definition: Trajectory of increasing responsibility and scope over career
traits.evidence: Budget size, team size, project scale mentioned over time

traits.name: Industry Depth vs Breadth
traits.definition: Pattern of industry specialization vs cross-sector experience
traits.evidence: Number and variety of industries worked in

traits.name: Seniority Alignment
traits.definition: Current career level relative to years of experience
traits.evidence: Current title vs total years of experience

traits.name: Qualification Level
traits.definition: Highest level of formal education attained
traits.evidence: Degrees listed (Associate, Bachelor, Master, PhD, etc.)

traits.name: Institutional Caliber
traits.definition: Reputation and relevance of educational institutions
traits.evidence: University names, rankings, specialized programs

traits.name: Field-of-Study Relevance
traits.definition: Alignment between academic background and career path
traits.evidence: Degree subject matter vs job roles held

traits.name: Continuous Learning Evidence
traits.definition: Recent professional development and ongoing education
traits.evidence: Recent courses, certifications, workshops attended

traits.name: Technical Skill Breadth
traits.definition: Range and variety of technical tools/technologies known
traits.evidence: Number of different tools, technologies, software listed

traits.name: Technical Skill Depth
traits.definition: Evidence of mastery level in technical competencies
traits.evidence: Years of experience, proficiency levels, certifications

traits.name: Technology Currency
traits.definition: Recency and modernity of technology stack
traits.evidence: Modern vs legacy technologies mentioned

traits.name: Tool Proficiency Density
traits.definition: Number of demonstrated competencies per career year
traits.evidence: Total skills vs years of experience ratio

traits.name: Cross-Domain Technical Ability
traits.definition: Technical proficiency across multiple domains
traits.evidence: Variety in types of technical skills

traits.name: Quantified Accomplishment Density
traits.definition: Frequency of metrics and numbers used to describe achievements
traits.evidence: Numbers, percentages, amounts per role description

traits.name: Project Scale Indicators
traits.definition: Evidence of large-scale project involvement
traits.evidence: Team sizes, budget amounts, user numbers, market reach

traits.name: Business Impact Evidence
traits.definition: Direct contributions to business outcomes
traits.evidence: Revenue growth, cost savings, efficiency gains stated

traits.name: Awards & Recognition
traits.definition: Formal acknowledgments and honors received
traits.evidence: Awards, honors, recognition programs mentioned

traits.name: Publication/Patent Record
traits.definition: Thought leadership through publications or patents
traits.evidence: Papers, articles, patents, books, conference talks

traits.name: People Management Evidence
traits.definition: Experience managing, supervising, or leading people
traits.evidence: Direct reports mentioned, team leadership roles

traits.name: Strategic Influence Indicators
traits.definition: Involvement in strategic planning and decision-making
traits.evidence: Strategy-related keywords, C-level interaction mentions

traits.name: Cross-Functional Coordination
traits.definition: Experience working across departments and functions
traits.evidence: Multi-department projects, cross-team collaboration

traits.name: Mentorship & Development
traits.definition: Experience developing others through mentoring/coaching
traits.evidence: Mentoring programs, training delivery, coaching activities

traits.name: Written Communication Quality
traits.definition: Quality of writing evident in CV itself
traits.evidence: Grammar, spelling, structure, clarity of CV

traits.name: Language Mastery
traits.definition: Number and proficiency level of languages spoken
traits.evidence: Languages listed with proficiency levels

traits.name: Professional Presentation
traits.definition: Quality of CV formatting and organization
traits.evidence: Structure, layout, use of space, visual hierarchy

traits.name: Articulation Precision
traits.definition: Clarity and specificity in describing roles and achievements
traits.evidence: Specific vs vague language, concrete examples

traits.name: Role Diversity Index
traits.definition: Variety in types of positions held throughout career
traits.evidence: Different job functions, role types across career

traits.name: Industry Transition Ability
traits.definition: Success in navigating changes between industry sectors
traits.evidence: Different industries worked in, sector changes

traits.name: Skill Acquisition Rate
traits.definition: Pace of learning new competencies over time
traits.evidence: New skills added over career progression

traits.name: Geographic/Cultural Mobility
traits.definition: Experience working in different locations or cultures
traits.evidence: Multiple cities/countries, international experience

traits.name: Technology Adoption Speed
traits.definition: Pace of adopting emerging tools and technologies
traits.evidence: Recently emerged tech in skillset vs career length
keywords: Modern tech names with recent dates

traits.name: Innovation Indicators
traits.definition: Evidence of creating new solutions or approaches
traits.evidence: Frequency of innovation-related action verbs

traits.name: Process Improvement Evidence
traits.definition: Track record of optimizing and enhancing systems
traits.evidence: Process improvement, efficiency mentions with metrics

traits.name: Initiative Demonstration
traits.definition: Evidence of self-started projects and proactive work
traits.evidence: Self-initiated projects, "launched", "founded" mentions

traits.name: Complex Problem Context
traits.definition: Difficulty level of challenges and problems addressed
traits.evidence: Complexity indicators in problem descriptions

traits.name: Achievement Density
traits.definition: Number of accomplishments relative to time in role
traits.evidence: Achievements listed per position vs tenure length

traits.name: Extra-Curricular Engagement
traits.definition: Professional engagement beyond primary role
traits.evidence: Side projects, volunteering, professional associations

traits.name: Certification Pursuit
traits.definition: Professional development commitment through certifications
traits.evidence: Number and recency of professional certifications

traits.name: Tenure Productivity
traits.definition: Output and impact achieved within each role period
traits.evidence: Accomplishments relative to length of employment

traits.name: Team Collaboration Frequency
traits.definition: Frequency of collaborative work mentions
traits.evidence: Team-related keywords throughout CV

traits.name: Stakeholder Management Evidence
traits.definition: Experience managing relationships with diverse stakeholders
traits.evidence: Client, vendor, partner, stakeholder interaction mentions

traits.name: Cross-Cultural Experience
traits.definition: Exposure to and work with international or diverse teams
traits.evidence: International work, diverse team mentions

traits.name: Soft Skill Demonstration
traits.definition: Evidence of interpersonal and emotional intelligence skills
traits.evidence: Soft skill keywords and behavioral evidence
